headline:
تعاون جديد
في Dragon's Dogma 2
label: متوفر الآن
note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type: OUT NOW / update. Mohammad: 'go ahead with all 4' and 'every Reel video first' (4 Nov). Hook: Delicious in Dungeon's Laios and Marcille come to Dragon's Dogma 2. Why now: Capcom's collaboration is live on PS5, Xbox Series and PC (Gematsu 3 Nov 19:45 EST, Nintendo Life 4 Nov), Switch 2 update 11 Nov PST. Players here: pawns hireable at Riftstones and two outfits given when a save is loaded; pawns and outfits until the 28 Jan 2027 title update (outfits stay usable after). Payoff: Switch 2 on 11 Nov. Footage route: Steam app 2054970 official trailer, a stretch from 14 s, stand-in footage named on screen; the collaboration trailer itself is on YouTube only (unreachable). picture: Dragon's Dogma 2 Steam trailer 14 to 35.6 s (no still). Sound: trailer's own sound. Names: Capcom bracketed. Sensitive: none. | v4: v1 stretch (14 to 35.6 s) failed the smear check at source 25.4 to 25.9 s; stretch moved to 26.0 to 47.6 s. picture: Dragon's Dogma 2 Steam trailer 26 to 47.6 s. | v5 17:10 Dubai: v4 sheet showed the Capcom Presents logo and burnt-in English subtitles on most of the trailer (logo 26 to 28.5 s; subtitles 33 to 37 s and 45 to 47.6 s). Only the clean windows 29.6 to 32.6, 39.2 to 41.8 and 41.8 to 44.7 s are cut. Sound: our bed because the trailer is narrated throughout (no music-only stretch).
